title: User-declared generic function: first<T> infers T at call sites
notes: rfd#56 phase 1 (dekaruntime/dsc#93): fn first<T>(items: Array<T>) Option<T> — the shape deka#561 predicted would need a user-written generic. T is inferred per call site (number, string), proving call-site inference works for user functions, not only builtins.
